title: Odd Word Out
prompt: Make me a bluffing party game for 3–10 friends around one phone: everyone gets a secret word, one person's word is slightly different, we describe and then vote out the odd one.
prompt_en: Make me a bluffing party game for 3–10 friends around one phone: everyone gets a secret word, one person's word is slightly different, we describe and then vote out the odd one.
